blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: In India's Parliamentary System, the President is the Nominal Executive and the Prime Minister is the Real Executive.
The Council of Ministers maintains collective responsibility to the Lok Sabha.
Power is divided between the Centre and States, establishing a Federal System.
During emergencies, the Centre becomes stronger, revealing a Unitary Bias.
Unitary features include Single Constitution, Single Citizenship, Strong Centre, Emergency provisions, and All India Services.
The Prime Minister is frequently asked in exams as the Real Executive of India.
The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible specifically to the Lok Sabha, not the Rajya Sabha.
Single Constitution, Single Citizenship, Emergency provisions, and All India Services are key features demonstrating Unitary Bias.

blocks.content:

Reasons:
